name: Paseo Colorado
description: Paseo Colorado is an upscale open-air lifestyle center located in the heart of downtown Pasadena, featuring a carefully curated mix of retail stores, restaurants, and entertainment venues. The center offers a pedestrian-friendly environment with Spanish-inspired architecture and convenient access to Old Pasadena's dining and cultural attractions. With its central location on Colorado Boulevard, Paseo Colorado serves as a premier shopping and gathering destination for the Pasadena community and visitors.
summary: Paseo Colorado is a Spanish-inspired open-air lifestyle center in downtown Pasadena offering upscale shopping, dining, and entertainment in a walkable urban environment.
